description: Starts a scan of a public homepage for cookies and tracking observed before consent interaction, or reuses recent evidence. Returns a scan ID and, for reused scans, the evidence timestamp when known and the domain cooldown end. The scan scope excludes private pages, legal verdicts, accept/reject testing, monitoring, and bulk scans. API documentation: https://cookierisk.eu/developers/mcp.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) homepage, for example https://example.com/; no path, query, credentials or fragment.

name: start_quickscan
title: Start a CookieRisk quickscan
